# Welcome Car A/C Service

Dedicated car air-conditioning workshop in Tharamani, Chennai. Specializing exclusively in car A/C diagnosis, refrigerant gas recharge, leak detection, and compressor repair. 15+ years of experience.

## Services

- A/C Diagnosis: Digital dual-gauge pressure scans and laser temperature delta measurement
- Cooling Problem Resolution: Resolving cabins that take too long to cool or blow warm air
- A/C Gas / Refrigerant Service: R134a & R1234yf vacuum recovery & recharge with OEM gram-weight precision
- A/C Leak Diagnosis: 250+ PSI nitrogen pressure testing and electronic halogen sniffing
- Compressor Service & Repair: Magnetic clutch air-gap adjustment, control valve testing, shaft seal refurbishment
- A/C System Repair & Overhaul: Component replacement and closed-loop solvent flushing
- Evaporator Coil & Cabin Air Quality: Deep foam sanitization and PM2.5 pollen filter replacement
- A/C Electrical & Sensor Diagnosis: Climate ECU data scan, thermistor testing, actuator checks
